newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers dip again, buyers await more losses.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers dip again, buyers await more losses.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices drifted down by $1 with demand thin, while bunkers in the rest of Europe were steady to soft, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at $87/$88, following a $1 loss in the barge market.

Total ARA volume was thin, although there was one large enquiry for 4,000 tonnes, concluded in the afternoon at $87.25. Traders added that some players, expecting further losses next week, took short bunker positions."
"There was quite a bit of short-taking, particularly this morning," one supplier said.
Premiums for the 180 CST remained high, as stock was thin and the material that was in tank had mostly been bought at higher prices.
Hamburg prices were steady, which left bunkers uncompetitive compared to Rotterdam and the market thin.
Mediterranean bunkers were steady to soft. Suppliers in all areas said business was quiet.
